DEATH NOTE (hospice) Kindred Meadow Hospice Patient: WINTER, KASH L DOB: 03/19/1993 MRN: HM-5530921 Hospice ID: KMH-2068-0418 Admitted to hospice: 08/18/2068 Attending of record: Dr. Blue Aldana Hospice MD: Halo Nwosu, MD Hospice RN: Lake Torres (different Lake - this is Lake Torres-Ibe, hospice side)
DATE / TIME OF DEATH: 09/04/2068 at 04:20 PLACE: Home, 2204 Bramble Hollow Rd, Marlowe, OH AGE AT DEATH: 75
Hx per template: 74 y.o. male with NSCLC, CKD 3, CAD s/p CABG, seizure disorder. Hospice course (copy forward from 08/25/2068 visit): comfortable, pain controlled, resting, eating little, wife Miracle at bedside. Dog on the bed.
Events: Called by wife at 04:05 re: no breathing. RN arrived 04:20, no pulse, no resp, no heart sounds x 1 min, pupils fixed. Pronounced by RN Lake Torres-Ibe. Family present: wife Miracle Winter, son Nyne, and mother Wednesday Winter (95, brought by a neighbor, Mr. Oyelaran). Brother Tre Winter informed by phone on Tuesday, flights booked.
- Cause of death: non-small cell lung cancer, progressive - Medical examiner not contacted, expected death - No autopsy. Organ donation: declined - Body released to Pelham & Sons Funeral Home, ph (513) 555-0105, at 07:30 - Pt had been a Marine; family requests flag, mother wants "Kash" on the stone not Kashmir (autocorrect). Cold, first winter frost that morning. - Death cert filed by Halo Nwosu; certificate no. OH-DC-68-559120
Bereavement packet mailed 09/06/2068 to Mrs. Winter.
Electronically signed by Halo Nwosu, MD on 09/04/2068 09:15 Dictated using voice recognition; "Halo" was heard as "hallow" and "Nyne" as "nine". pls disregard.
